title: Dynamo v1.5.0-motif-3-dev.1
text:
Release Notes
Dynamo v1.5.0-motif-3-dev.1 is an experimental snapshot build with early Motif-3 NVFP4 support on the Dynamo vLLM backend. It is not recommended for production and is not a QA-gated release. APIs, behavior, and defaults may change before stable support. Use it for evaluation, testing, and early feedback only.
Summary
Dynamo v1.5.0-motif-3-dev.1 serves Motif-Technologies/Motif-3-NVFP4 on Dynamo vLLM. The runtime image is an amd64 CUDA 13.0 build on Motif's vLLM v0.26.0-motif3 base, with vLLM-Omni disabled so that base can serve without vllm-rs (#15332).
The Kubernetes recipe is aggregated-only: two B200 GPUs, tensor parallelism 2, expert parallelism, Dynamo MTP2 speculative decoding, an FP8 KV cache, and a 262,144-token context. It includes a shared model-cache PVC and Hugging Face download Job, plus an AIPerf 0.13.0 chat-trace Job at concurrency 11. The recipe from #15534 is on this branch in #15536 (recipe folder).

About Motif-3
Motif-3 NVFP4 is Motif Technologies' preview checkpoint published on Hugging Face as Motif-Technologies/Motif-3-NVFP4. This build serves it through Dynamo's vLLM backend as an aggregated two-GPU B200 deployment with MTP2 speculative decoding.
Full Changelog
vLLM Backend
Motif vLLM runtime: amd64 Dynamo vLLM runtime on Motif's v0.26.0-motif3 image, with vLLM-Omni disabled so the Motif base can serve without vllm-rs (#15332).
Recipes
Motif-3 NVFP4 recipe: Added recipes/motif-3 — shared model-cache PVC and Hugging Face download Job, one aggregated B200 chat profile (TP2, expert parallelism, Dynamo MTP2, FP8 KV cache, 262K context), and an AIPerf 0.13.0 chat-trace Job at concurrency 11 (recipe folder, README, #15536, #15534).
Getting Started
Deployment is Kubernetes-based (Dynamo Platform + DynamoGraphDeployment). Full steps — namespace, hf-token-secret, model-cache PVC, download Job, aggregated DGD apply, and a /v1/chat/completions smoke test — are in the recipe README. The base manifest has no cluster-specific scheduling; use the Kustomization in that folder to add node selectors or tolerations. The download Job is the only step that needs the Hugging Face token. No image-pull secret is required for the public runtime image.
Known Issues / Limitations
Experimental snapshot build — not QA-gated; not for production.
Aggregated serving only. There is no disaggregated Motif-3 profile.
The vLLM runtime image is amd64 only, and the recipe references it by tag rather than digest.
The runtime image carries Motif-specific vLLM compatibility code. Do not replace its vLLM package with an unrelated wheel.
Shipped manifests use real MTP verification. Figures measured with synthetic acceptance length 2.13 are a benchmark-only proxy and are not reproduced by the manifests as shipped. A real-MTP chat-trace result is not attached.
In the reference 8K/1K chat trace, 35 requests exceed the 262,144-token context limit.
